item.title: New Year's Eve power outage in San Francisco piles onto frustrations with PG&E
item.description: Thousands of people in the Richmond District lost power on New Year's Eve in the third major outage in two weeks.

item.title: 'Zootopia 2' is now Disney Animation's highest-grossing film
item.description: "Zootopia 2" is now Walt Disney Animation's number one movie of all time.

item.title: Trump, in interview, defends his energy and health, offers new details on screening he underwent
item.description: President Donald Trump defended his energy and health in an interview with The Wall Street Journal and disclosed that he had a CT scan, not an MRI scan.

item.title: Health subsidies expire, launching millions of Americans into 2026 with steep insurance hikes
item.description: Enhanced tax credits that have helped Americans offset the cost of Affordable Care Act health insurance for the last four years expired overnight.

item.title: Pope opens 2026 with plea for peace in countries bloodied by war, families wounded by violence
item.description: Pope Leo XIV opened 2026 on Thursday with a plea for peace, singling out in particular countries "bloodied by conflict" and families wounded by violence.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Dry skies overnight; atmospheric river moves in late Friday
item.description: As we head into tonight and early Friday morning, conditions appear to dry out a bit as a weak shortwave ridge builds into the region. This will be short-lived before an atmospheric river moves through Friday night into Saturday.

item.title: New DROP tool helps CA residents prevent their personal info from being sold
item.description: California's DROP program is now active, giving residents the ability to stop data brokers from selling their personal information. Here's how you can use the new tool.

item.title: Big political battles ahead for California in 2026: Here's what to look forward to
item.description: The year 2026 is sure to bring another round of big political battles and shifts in leadership ahead of what's expected to be a hotly contested midterm election season. Here's some of what we can expect.

item.title: 19-year-old hiker found dead on Mount Baldy identified as Seal Beach resident
item.description: A 19-year-old hiker who was found dead on Mount Baldy has been identified as a Seal Beach resident.

item.title: San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie signs measure to create reparations fund for Black residents
item.description: San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie signed a measure last week that would create a fund to help Black people who have been harmed by past city laws. The measure, however, does not allocate any city dollars for those payouts.
